answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The lantern lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the grove is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
